description: Convert delimited text to a table (Table > Convert Text to Table): a whole story, a character range of it, or the selected text

columnSeparator.description: Column Separator: tab, comma, paragraph, semicolon, space, or any single character

columns.description: Number of columns; needed when the column and row separators are the same

headerRows.description: Make this many of the first rows header rows

rowSeparator.description: Row Separator: tab, comma, paragraph, semicolon, space, or any single character

source.description: The text to convert: a story (by frameId or storyId), optionally a character range of it, or selection: true

end.description: Character index just after the last one to convert (default: the end of the story)

frameId.description: Id of a text frame; its story is used

start.description: First character to convert (default: the start of the story)

name: convert_text_to_table
title: Convert Text To Table
